settings.trashNote: Photos moved to the trash stay in the library folder and are restored exactly as they were. After this period, they are deleted when Afterdusk starts. The backup is never touched.
settings.sameDisk: This folder is on the same disk as the library: if that disk fails, both copies are lost.

settings.backupHint: The backup applies to future imports; photos already imported are not copied again.
settings.templatesHint: Templates apply to future imports; photos already filed do not move.

status.safetyHint: Afterdusk never modifies your originals: ratings and settings are written to the database and to an XMP sidecar file.

library.title: Where should your photos go?
library.text: Afterdusk copies your photos into this folder, organised by date and album. The originals on the card are never modified. Pick a disk with room to spare; you can add more libraries later.
library.name: Name

backup.title: A second copy with every import
backup.text: Each imported photo can also be copied to another disk, verified by checksum. Nothing is ever deleted from it automatically. You can also choose it later in the settings.

folders.title: How should imports be organised?
folders.text: One dated folder per outing is the most common choice. The camera's file names can be kept as they are.

identity.title: Who signs these photos?
identity.text: Your name and copyright are written to the XMP files on import, readable by other software. Everything is optional.
